name: functions
description: Cloud Functions for Firebase - Blue4 CommonGrounds

scripts.test:rules: npm run build && npx firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project common-grounds-rules --only firestore "node --test lib/firestore.rules.test.js"
scripts.test:flows: npm run build && npx firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project common-grounds-flow --only firestore "node --test lib/wave_flow.test.js"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:flows
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
